violation_type.title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Single Use Items if Cannot Sanitize (26 TAC §746.3317(2))
violation_type.short_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Single Use Items if Cannot Sanitize
violation_type.typical_finding: Food service equipment, such as bowls, utensils and bottles, are not being sanitized.  Noted, that these items are being cleaned with dish soap and water.
